$description: Typography: families, weights, tracking, the display face's cap-height ratio, and the type levels. Measured from the LCARS resume PDF and the thejase.com LCARS lab. Sizes are not tokens: display text takes its size from the bar it sits in (spec/type.md).

display.$description: Condensed display face for labels, headings and readouts. Antonio (SIL Open Font License, https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Antonio) stands in for Swiss 911 Ultra Compressed, the LCARS face, which is commercial.

body.$description: Reading face for running text. Lato (SIL Open Font License, https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Lato), weights 300 and 400.

tracking.$description: Letter spacing in em, measured from the PDF (InDesign units / 1000).

cap-ratio.$description: Display face cap height per em: Antonio's 1760 of 2048 units. Display text set in a bar of height b takes font-size b / cap-ratio, so its caps fill the bar exactly.

body-leading.$description: Body line height: 14pt leading on 9pt type.

title.$description: The largest display line, such as a name or page title. Caps fill the bar.

row-label.$description: A label that fills a row, such as MAIL or WWW.

heading.$description: A section heading set in its section bar.

label.$description: Names and titles beside content, such as employer names and job titles.

meta.$description: Codes, dates and contact values: small display text.
